gate_1_clean_install_start_status.notes: Supervised tree owns M0 filesystem, process broker, M1 session daemon, user-session worker, FastMCP gateway. Dynamic loopback ports, idempotent double-start, stale manifest recovery, HKCU Run autostart, and clean purge uninstall validated.

gate_2_one_mcp_endpoint_expected_tools.notes: Unified FastMCP surface exposing amf_capabilities, amf_execute, amf_health, and amf_tool_catalog.

gate_3_stdio_and_streamable_http.notes: FastMCP handles both stdio IPC transport and Streamable HTTP SSE transport.

gate_4_filesystem_process_browser_e2e.notes: M0 filesystem read/write, process broker start/read/stop, and M1 browser DOM action with before/after evidence pass end-to-end.

gate_5_truthful_ledger_and_health.notes: Local SQLite usage ledger persists across gateway restarts, logs execution/timing/errors, and truthful health marks DEGRADED on dead worker without inventing fake ONLINE.

gate_6_plugin_discovery.notes: Typed Plugin/Adapter SDK with inspect, prepare, execute, observe, reconcile, cleanup hooks. Dynamic discovery from approved directory, disabled plugin filtering, crash isolation, and version in provenance.

gate_7_remote_second_client.notes: Authenticated user-owned private remote adapter. Unauthenticated client DENIED 401, authenticated client read and bounded mutation PASS, reconnect replay preserving operation_id semantics, transport failure leaves local DC healthy.

gate_8_crash_restart_replay_no_duplicate.notes: Durable receipts and operation_id idempotence proven across filesystem, process, browser, and remote adapter.

gate_9_rollback_uninstall.notes: Installer and runtime uninstall purges all installed files, binaries, native messaging manifests, and Windows Registry keys with zero residual state.

gate_10_hosted_rdc_optional_only.notes: Sovereign Desktop Commander is fully autonomous on host machine; hosted Desktop Commander relay is optional fallback only.
